description: Snow Plow Activity (2015-2016) is a dataset listed in Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center (WPRDC), an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Pittsburgh. Snow Plow data from the the City of Pittsburgh's Snow Plow Tracker. These data are collected from the Snow Plow Tracker's Fusion Table and converted to geoJSON. Each file is named using the timestamp representation of the date and time the corresponding 'Snow Event' started. Coverage: Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. The portal files it under the publisher City of Pittsburgh. Its tags are 2015, 2016, plow, plowing, road. It offers 17 resource(s) in GEOJSON. The portal shows 2024-06-13 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-wprdc-portal.
